'''2009 Worlds Day 3 Matthew Sokol DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Sokol]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' Mr Purple
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
